title: SvgFeImage
responsibility: Renders the native feImage element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgFeImage.attributes
inputs.description: Native feImage attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: SvgFeImage.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native feImage element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: SvgFeImage
outputs.description: The actual native feImage element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
